key_insight: Marformer is a Transformer that directly predicts conditional marginals for missing variables from observed values, enabling single-pass uncertainty estimates without modeling the full joint distribution.
engineering_relevance: This is useful for decision systems under missing data because it supports Bayes-risk and value-of-information calculations faster than generative missing-data methods.
method: Builds a hidden-vector representation for each target distribution p(X_i).
Iteratively refines each distribution via attention over other distributions p(X_j).
Trains directly on conditional marginals, with no requirement for domain-specific generative assumptions.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on synthetic Bayesian networks, discretized multivariate Gaussians, structured annotation data, and a real annotation dataset, where it matched or beat strong baselines and was substantially faster.
watch_item: Because it predicts marginals rather than the full joint, downstream methods that need complex joint dependencies or calibrated uncertainty across many variables may require extra validation.
paper_title: Marformer: A Transformer for Predicting Missing Data Distributions
